definitions.gloss: makuuchi; the top division of sumo
definitions.explanation: The highest division of professional sumo, about 42 wrestlers, from the rank-and-file maegashira up to the grand champions; its bouts are the ones shown in full on television.

examples.japanese: {幕内|まくうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: He was promoted to the top division.

examples.japanese: {幕内|まくうち}⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四十二人|よんじゅうににん}⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

{新入幕|しんにゅうまく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{幕内|まくうち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{勝|か}ち{越|こ}し→勝ち越す：32577_kachikosu⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沸|わ}いた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: The hall erupted when the newly promoted wrestler secured a winning record in his first top-division tournament.

notes:
Also read まくのうち.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕内|まくうち}⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧: a top-division wrestler
- {幕内|まくうち}⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧: winning the top-division championship
- {新入幕|しんにゅうまく}: newly promoted to the top division

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧, ⟦{大関|おおぜき}→大関：12662_oozeki⟧: the highest ranks within {幕内|まくうち}
